Metadata.title: Warif | Understand your cycle
Metadata.description: Warif is a private, safe Arabic women's wellness app for tracking the menstrual cycle and daily health, with medically reviewed content and a supportive community.

Common.tagline: Understand your cycle. Care for yourself. You are not alone.

Landing.heroEyebrow: Your calm space to care for yourself
Landing.heroSubtitle: Warif is a calm space to understand your cycle and daily health, with real privacy and a safe Arabic community.
Landing.feature1Body: Log your cycle, symptoms, mood, energy and sleep in under thirty seconds.
Landing.feature2Body: Understand your personal patterns through a clear calendar and predictions shown as estimates, not certainties.
Landing.feature3Body: Read trustworthy Arabic health articles with the reviewer's name, sources and last update date.
Landing.feature4Body: Share your experience in a supportive, moderated women's community without revealing your real identity.
Landing.privacyTitle: Your privacy is a core feature
Landing.privacyBody: We separate your identity data from your health data, never sell your data, and never use it for targeted ads. Export and deletion are always available.
Landing.disclaimerBody: Warif is a tracking, education and support tool, not a diagnostic or treatment tool. All cycle and ovulation dates are fallible estimates and must not be used as contraception.
